paragraphs: Unless the context indicates otherwise, all references to "FCPT," the "Company," "we," "our" or "us" include Four Corners Property Trust, Inc. and all of its consolidated subsidiaries.

The Company was incorporated in Maryland in July 2015. The Company was formed as a wholly owned subsidiary of Darden Restaurants, Inc. ("Darden") and became an independent publicly traded company four months later following the completion of its separation from Darden in November 2015.

We are a real estate investment trust ("REIT") which owns, acquires and leases properties for use in the restaurant and retail industries. Substantially all of our business is conducted through Four Corners Operating Partnership, LP ("FCPT OP"), a Delaware limited partnership of which we are a majority limited partner and our wholly owned subsidiary, Four Corners GP, LLC ("FCPT GP"), is its sole general partner. We believe that we have operated in conformity with the requirements for qualification and taxation as a REIT for the taxable year ended December 31, 2025, and we intend to continue to operate in a manner that will enable us to maintain our qualification as a REIT.

Our revenues are primarily generated by leasing properties to tenants through net lease arrangements under which the tenants are primarily responsible for ongoing costs relating to the properties, including utilities, property taxes, insurance, common area maintenance charges, and maintenance and repair costs. We focus on income producing properties leased to high quality tenants in major markets across the United States. We also generate revenues by operating the Kerrow Restaurant Operating Business pursuant to franchise agreements with Darden.

In addition to managing our existing properties, our strategy includes investing in additional restaurant and retail properties to grow and diversify our existing portfolio. We expect this acquisition strategy will decrease our reliance on Darden and help us gain exposure to non-restaurant retail properties over time. We intend to purchase properties that are well located, occupied by durable concepts, with creditworthy tenants whose operating cash flows are expected to meaningfully exceed their lease payments to us. We seek to improve the probability of successful tenant renewal at the end of initial lease terms by acquiring properties that have high levels of operator profitability compared to rent payments and have absolute rent levels that reflect market rates.

In 2025, FCPT engaged in various real estate transactions for a total investment of $325.5 million, including capitalized transaction costs. Pursuant to these transactions, we acquired 105 rental properties and ground leasehold interests, aggregating 713.9 thousand square feet.
As of December 31, 2025, our lease portfolio had the following characteristics:
• 1,303 free-standing properties located in 48 states and representing an aggregate leasable area of 8.8 million square feet;
• 99.6% occupancy (based on leasable square footage); • An average remaining lease term of 6.9 years (weighted by annualized base rent);
• An average annual rent escalation of 1.5%1 through December 31, 2030 (weighted by annualized base rent); and
• 53% investment-grade tenancy (weighted by annualized base rent). Segments

We operate in two segments, real estate operations and restaurant operations. Our segments are based on our organizational and management structure, which aligns with how our results are monitored and performance is assessed.

Our real estate operations segment consists of rental revenues primarily generated by leasing restaurant and retail properties to tenants through net lease arrangements under which the tenant is primarily responsible for ongoing costs relating to the properties. Our real estate operations segment also includes expenses associated with continuing efforts to invest in additional restaurant and retail properties and our corporate operating expenses.

Our restaurant operations segment is conducted through a taxable REIT subsidiary ("TRS") and consists of our Kerrow Restaurant Operating Business. The associated sales revenues, restaurant expenses and overhead on Kerrow Restaurant Operating Business's seven buildings and equipment comprise our restaurant operations.

headings: Risks related to real estate ownership could reduce the value of our properties, which could materially and adversely affect us.

We are dependent on our major tenants successfully operating their businesses, and a failure to do so could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial position or results of operations.
A significant portion of our restaurant properties are Olive Garden properties. Therefore, we are subject to risks associated with having a highly concentrated property brand base.
We are dependent on the restaurant industry and may be susceptible to the risks associated with it, which could materially adversely affect our business, financial position or results of operations.
Our portfolio has some geographic concentration, which makes us more susceptible to adverse events in these areas.
Our pursuit of investments in, and acquisitions or development of, additional properties may be unsuccessful or fail to meet our expectations.
Inflation may materially and adversely affect us and our tenants.
If we are not able to hire, or if we lose, key management personnel, we may not be able to successfully manage our business and achieve our objectives.
Failure by our tenants to make rental payments to us, because of a deterioration of their financial condition or otherwise, would have a material adverse effect on us.
Bankruptcy laws will limit our remedies if a tenant becomes bankrupt and rejects its leases.
The failure of any of our tenants to fulfill their maintenance obligations may have a materially adverse effect on our ability to operate and grow our business.
Environmental compliance costs and liabilities associated with real estate properties owned by us may materially impair the value of those investments.
Our relationship with Darden may adversely affect our ability to do business with third-party restaurant operators and other tenants.

Real estate investments are relatively illiquid and provisions in our lease agreements may adversely impact our ability to sell properties and could adversely impact the price at which we can sell the properties.
We may be subject to liabilities and costs associated with the impacts of climate change.
Compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act and fire, safety and other regulations may require us to make unanticipated expenditures that materially adversely impact our cash flow.
Our active management and operation of a restaurant business may expose us to potential liabilities beyond those traditionally associated with REITs.
We may be vulnerable to security breaches or cyber-attacks which could disrupt our operations and have a material adverse effect on our financial performance and operating results.
If our reputation or our tenants' reputation are damaged, our business and operating results may be harmed.
Third-party expectations relating to environmental, social and governance factors may impose additional costs and expose us to new risks.

Covenants in our debt agreements may limit our operational flexibility, and a covenant breach or default could materially and adversely affect our business, financial position or results of operations.

本公司於 2015 年 7 月在馬裏蘭州註冊成立。本公司為 Darden Restaurants, Inc.（"Darden"）的 wholly owned subsidiary，並在 2015 年 11 月完成與 Darden 分離後，四個月後成為獨立公開上市的公司。

我們為一間 REIT（"REIT"），擁有、取得並出租用於餐飲及零售業的不動產。我們業務的 substantially all 皆透過 Four Corners Operating Partnership, LP（"FCPT OP"）進行，為一間德拉瓦州有限合夥企業，我們為其主要有限合夥人，且我們的 wholly owned subsidiary，Four Corners GP, LLC（"FCPT GP"），為其唯一普通合夥人。我們相信我們已符合 2025 年 12 月 31 日結算年度的 REIT 資格及稅務要求，並有意繼續以符合 REIT 資格的方式運作。
我們的收入主要來自透過淨租賃安排出租不動產給租戶，租戶主要負責與不動產相關的持續費用，包括電力、不動產稅、保險、公共區域維護費用及維修與修繕費用。我們專注於出租給高品質租戶的收入產生型不動產，這些不動產位於美國主要市場。我們也透過與 Darden 簽訂特許經營協議，經營 Kerrow 餐廳營運業務來產生收入。

除了管理現有不動產，我們的策略包括投資更多餐飲及零售不動產，以成長並多元化我們現有資產組合。我們預期此收購策略將減少我們對 Darden 的依賴，並幫助我們逐步獲得非餐飲零售不動產的投資機會。我們意圖購買位於優良地段、由具備長久經營概念且信用良好的租戶佔據的不動產，其營運現金流預期將遠高於其支付給我們的租金。我們尋求透過取得具有高經營利潤率與租金支付相比較，且絕對租金水平反映市場價格的不動產，來提高租約到期後租戶續約成功的機率。
2025 年，FCPT 進行了多項不動產交易，總投資為 325.5 百萬美元，包括資本化交易成本。根據這些交易，我們取得了 105 個出租不動產及地面租賃權益，總計 713.9 千平方英呎。
截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們的租賃資產組合具有以下特徵：
• 1,303 個獨立不動產，位於 48 個州，總計可出租面積為 8.8 百萬平方英呎；
• 99.6% 使用率（基於可出租平方英呎計算）； • 平均剩餘租約期間為 6.9 年（按年化基本租金加權計算）；
• 平均年租金上漲率為 1.5%1 至 2030 年 12 月 31 日（按年化基本租金加權計算）；以及
• 53% 的投資等級租戶（按年化基本租金加權計算）。分部
我們經營兩個分部，即不動產營運及餐飲營運。我們的分部係根據我們的組織及管理架構，與我們的營運成果監測及績效評估方式一致。
我們的不動產營運分部主要由出租餐飲及零售不動產所產生的租金收入組成，透過淨租賃安排，租戶主要負擔與不動產相關的持續費用。我們的不動產營運分部亦包含持續投資於更多餐飲及零售不動產的費用，以及我們的公司營運費用。
我們的餐飲營運分部透過可課稅REIT子公司（"TRS"）進行，包含我們的Kerrow餐飲營運業務。與Kerrow餐飲營運業務的七棟建築物及設備相關的銷售收入、餐飲費用及營運開銷，組成我們的餐飲營運。

本公司為馬裏蘭州公司，並為一間擁有、取得及出租物業以供用於餐飲及零售業之不動產投資信託（「REIT」）。本公司業務 substantially all 透過Four Corners Operating Partnership, LP（「FCPT OP」）進行，為一間德克薩斯州有限合夥企業，本公司為其主要有限合夥人，而本公司全資子公司Four Corners GP, LLC（「FCPT GP」）為其唯一普通合夥人。本公司相信本公司已符合於2025年12月31日結算之課稅年度取得並納稅為REIT之要求，並有意繼續以符合REIT資格之方式運作。
本公司之收入主要來自於透過淨租賃安排出租物業予租戶，租戶主要負擔與物業相關之持續費用，包括電力、物業稅、保險、公共區域維護費用及維修費用。本公司專注於出租予高品質租戶之收入產生型物業，這些物業位於美國主要市場。本公司亦透過與Darden簽訂特許經營協議，經營位於德州聖安東尼奧地區之七家LongHorn Steakhouse餐廳（「Kerrow餐廳營運業務」）而產生收入。
除管理現有物業外，本公司策略亦包括投資於其他餐飲及零售物業，以擴張並多元化現有資產組合。本公司預期此收購策略將逐漸減少對Darden之依賴。本公司意圖購買位於優良地段、由具備長久經營概念之租戶佔據，且租戶之營運現金流預期將明顯高於其支付予本公司之租金之物業。本公司旨在透過購買具高經營利潤率之物業，相較於租金支付，以提高租戶於租賃期滿時成功續約之機率，且租金水平通常反映市場價格。
2025年，FCPT進行多項不動產交易，總投資金額為325.5 百萬美元，包括交易成本之資本化。依此交易，本公司取得105處物業及地面租賃權，總計713.9 千平方英呎，並代表35個品牌，包括Chuy's、Crash Champions、Hawaiian Bros、Little Caesar's、Mission Pet Health及United Rentals。
截至2025年12月31日，本公司之租賃組合具有以下特徵：
• 1,303處物業，位於48個州，總可出租面積為8.8 百萬平方英呎；
• 99.6% 使用率（基於可出租平方英呎數）； • 平均剩餘租賃期限為 6.9 年（按年化基本租金加權計算）；
• 平均年租金上漲率為 1.5% 1 至 2030 年 12 月 31 日（按年化基本租金加權計算）；和
• 2025 年度結帳年度的契約基本租金回收率為 99.8%。

headings: 與實業所有權相關的風險可能會降低我們的不動產價值，這可能會對我們造成重大且不利的影響。
我們依賴主要租戶成功運作其業務，若未能做到，可能會對我們的業務、財務狀況或營運成果造成重大且不利的影響。
我們的餐廳不動產中，有相當大一部分為 Olive Garden 不動產。因此，我們面臨因不動產品牌集中度高而產生的相關風險。
我們依賴餐飲業，可能面臨與此產業相關的風險，這可能會對我們的業務、財務狀況或營運成果造成重大且不利的影響。
我們的投資組合在地理上有所集中，這使我們更容易受到這些地區不利事件的影響。
我們追求在更多不動產上進行投資，以及收購或開發這些不動產，可能無法成功或未達成我們的預期。
通貨膨脹可能會對我們及我們的租戶造成重大且不利的影響。
若我們無法聘請，或失去，關鍵管理人員，我們可能無法成功管理我們的業務並達成我們的目標。
本公司租戶未能依時向本公司支付租金，因租戶財務狀況惡化或其他原因，將對本公司產生重大不利影響。
若租戶陷入破產並拒絕履行租約，破產法將限制本公司可採取的救濟措施。
任一租戶未能履行其維護義務，可能對本公司營運及業務成長產生重大不利影響。
本公司所擁有之不動產，因環境法規遵循成本及相關責任，可能對該等投資之價值造成重大損害。
本公司與 Darden 之關係，可能對本公司與第三方餐飲經營者及其他租戶進行業務之能力產生不利影響。
不動產投資屬較為流動性差之資產，且租約條款可能對本公司出售不動產之能力產生不利影響，並可能影響出售價格。
本公司可能因氣候變遷之影響而面臨相關責任及成本。
遵守美國殘障法案及消防、安全等其他法規，可能要求本公司進行未預期之支出，對本公司現金流產生重大不利影響。
本公司積極經營與管理餐飲業務，可能使我們面臨傳統上與REITs相關之外的潛在責任。
我們可能面臨安全漏洞或網路攻擊的風險，此等事件可能幹擾我們的營運，並對我們的財務表現及營運成果造成重大不利影響。
